rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a leash used on a dog.

example.english: This dog always runs around, so remember to fasten the leash before going out.
example.traditional: 呢隻狗成日周街亂跑，出門口記住扣好狗帶。
example.jyutping: ne1 zek3 gau2 seng4 jat6 zau1 gaai1 lyun6 paau2 ceot1 mun4 hau2 gei3 zyu6 kau3 hou2 gau2 daai2

rows.note: Use this more precise term when the leash is described as a lead for controlling an animal, including one that is not a dog.

example.english: We need to keep this horse on a leash, or it’ll get lost.
example.traditional: 呢匹馬要用牽引繩牽住，唔係會走失㗎。
example.jyutping: ne1 pat1 maa5 jiu3 jung6 hin1 jan5 sing2 hin1 zyu6 m4 hai6 wui6 zau2 sat1 gaa3
